description_en: Queries the status information about vulnerability scan tasks on a server
description_zh: 查询指定机器漏洞扫描任务状态
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-vul-check-task-status-detail --task-ids ad8afca3914a5fff4636e67f18e259c7 --types sca --uuid 5d55af3c-35f3-4d4d-8ccc-8c5443b00000 --resource-directory-account-id 1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVulCheckTaskStatusDetail

parameters.help_en: The types of the vulnerabilities that are detected by the tasks
parameters.help_zh: 一键扫描对应的漏洞类型列表
parameters.name: types

TaskStatuses.description_en: An array that consists of the status information about the vulnerability scan tasks on the server
TaskStatuses.description_zh: 机器的漏洞任务状态列表

items.description_en: The struct of the status information about the vulnerability scan task
items.description_zh: 漏洞主任务状态结构体

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the main task

TaskStatusList.description_en: An array that consists of status information about the vulnerability scan subtask
TaskStatusList.description_zh: 漏洞检测任务状态列表

items.description_en: The struct of the status information about the vulnerability scan subtask
items.description_zh: 漏洞子任务状态结构体

Status.description_en:
The status of the subtask. Valid values:

0: unhandled
1: collecting
2: collected
3: matching
4: complete
Status.description_zh:
检查完成的状态。取值：

0：未处理
1：采集中
2：采集完成
3：匹配中
4：已完成

Type.description_en:
The type of the vulnerability. Valid values:

cve: Linux software vulnerability
sys: Windows system vulnerability
cms: Web-CMS vulnerability
sca: vulnerability that is detected based on software component analysis
Type.description_zh:
漏洞类型。取值：
cve：Linux软件漏洞
sys：Windows系统漏洞
cms：Web-CMS漏洞
sca：sca漏洞

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of vulnerability scan tasks on the server
TotalCount.description_zh: 机器对应的漏洞子任务总数
